rationale.consistency: Follows sibling cmd layout, license header, gitindex.Options usage and index.Options.Flags; writes to io.Writers instead of log and uses sort.Slice where the codebase is on modern Go, minor deviations.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles duplicate roots, missing/non-dir roots, root-is-repo, .git files (worktrees), tombstoned and compound shards, companion .meta files; root '/' or a '.git' root yields odd names, remove -f on a missing index dir gives a confusing lock error.
rationale.scope: Core requirement delivered plus a small README note; but the dry-run 'Up to date' preview re-implements ~100 lines of gitindex's private branch-expansion/commit-resolution logic, which was not asked for.
rationale.readability: Clear names and helpful comments; small units; naming a function `sync` and a type `record` is slightly vague but not confusing.
rationale.robustness: flock via golang.org/x/sys/unix is Unix-only in a repo that otherwise avoids platform-specific syscalls; NameFromGitConfig defaults to the new behaviour so any unupdated IndexGitRepo caller silently changes; otherwise sound error handling and lock release.
rationale.maintainability: Duplicated copies of expandBranches/getCommit/plainOpenRepo will drift from gitindex; inverted opt-out flag polarity is a hidden trap for future callers; shard inventory/records model is otherwise reusable and tidy.
